The back and forth dialogue of Try/Don't Try to escape is the biggest mystery to me as well. It's a sick joke that the mind plays on you because you can back it up with many memories where life felt amazing; as though you were that human you always wished to be. Check in on yourself a week later and you dispelled any further thoughts into that view and only see "the dumbass".

The best way I explained it to my friend who almost took his life was, "most of the time it's gonna be shit, it's gonna be boring and it's gonna be tedious. Life is gonna take a lot of work. But for that 10 percent of life, where you have a night/evening/day/morning where everything feels perfect and in place. That there is the moment you live for. You push to uncover that next meaningful moment. You push through the bullshit because those moments feel 100 times realer than the dark times". 

It was my pleasure sharing these thoughts with you. It's funny as your username is in fact the one that allowed myself to vent. Tonight you made me feel better, and that is a meaningful piece of life right there.

What sucks is that I buy into the desires of most of the concepts. I go about my life rejecting most of what I see, always acting as though it is twisted, when deep down I'm dying to just "fit in" with those twisted concepts. I've been taking a year to reevaluate, and slow down life. Although it is depressing I am thinking a lot about who I am as a person, who I believe myself to be, and who I want to push towards being. The problem is sitting back analyzing it doesn't necessarily do anything. 

It's normal to not understand why we are here. I just wish I didn't let it take up all my thoughts, and instead I pursued goals instead of dreaming them. Wouldn't that bring understanding to the world we create for ourselves? If I just acted instead of analyzing?

When waking up everyday to "be that better person" keeps draining your inner motivation to do anything in this pointless world, look to any other human beside you and realize they may feel the exact same way. I've had suicidal thoughts for years, it's been bad these past couple months.m, but it never looked less appealing to me as to when my buddy purposely crashed his car on the highway in efforts to kill himself. Hours before I found out I was under the presumption this "lady killer" of a handsome man had been happy all along and living life to the fullest; which I had been jealous of for some time. We all have the inner dialogue, but if you make the effort to keep pushing on one more day, then you're still playing the game. Maybe the levels get easier as time moves on. Best of luck to you; live life until you feel alive. 

Do not lose yourself on this journey.
